articles.title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
articles.description: The flaw was fixed in October 2025 and kept quiet until Tuesday. It came out alongside a high-severity bug that could stop a miner from producing blocks until someone restarted it.

articles.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
articles.description: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.

articles.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
articles.description: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

articles.title: Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
articles.description: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.

articles.title: Nvidia board meeting to decide CEO Jensen Huang’s fate stretches into evening
articles.description: Nvidia's board is meeting days after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman who is believed by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy.

articles.title: The world's super-rich are piling into alternative investments. Here's why
articles.description: Alternative investments now account for 60% of single-family office portfolios, surpassing traditional assets for the first time, according to BNY Wealth.

articles.title: Elon Musk says it would be an 'honor' to hire Nvidia's Jensen Huang
articles.description: The post on X comes amid reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust Huang.

articles.title: What we know so far about Nvidia partner Megaspeed’s Asia footprint
articles.description: Megaspeed is at the center of a U.S. probe over its role in sending billions of restricted Nvidia chips to China, and its executive's alleged affair with Jensen Huang.

articles.title: CFTC investigates if Kalshi improperly self-certified event contracts
articles.description: News of the probe comes after the CFTC ordered Kalshi to take down a sports-related "mention markets" back in August.

articles.title: Cramer's stance on Nvidia's stock amid reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be ousted
articles.description: Jim Cramer said Wednesday night that he was saddened by a news report that indicated Nvidia's board of directors is preparing to fire Huang.

articles.title: Meta head of infrastructure will leave and be succeeded by former AWS cloud exec
articles.description: Meta's head of infrastructure and co-head of engineering Santosh Janardhan will leave in 2027, with former AWS senior vice president David Brown taking over.

articles.title: MSCI confirms Strategy’s removal from indexes at end of November
articles.description: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI’s final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.

articles.title: Inside India newsletter: Trump's poll setback fuels hope for U.S.-India trade deal by year end
articles.description: While American voters are more affected by import duties on Canadian goods, experts said that a trade deal with India could blunt criticism against tariffs.

articles.title: Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate election over incumbent Republican Hyde-Smith
articles.description: Scott Colom will be the first Democrat elected to the Senate from the state since 1982, and Mississippi's first Black senator since Reconstruction.

articles.title: Suiet wallet to shut down in latest exit from Sui ecosystem
articles.description: The self-custodial wallet will keep its API services running through Nov. 14. Sui’s DeFi total value locked has fallen more than 22% over the past month.

articles.title: Feds arrest top official of healthcare company, alleging illegal drug importation
articles.description: U.S. officials are accusing two top officials of a Canadian company of operating a scheme to illegally import prescription drugs, court records show.

articles.title: Jensen Huang affair in D.C.: Resignation calls and moves to tighten Nvidia China exports
articles.description: Huang was notably opposed to strict export controls on AI chips to China, which ruffled feathers with congressional China hawks.

articles.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after affairs: WSJ
articles.description: The report about Huang’s possible departure came after the New York Times reported that he had a second extramarital affair.

articles.title: Nvidia-Backed CoreWeave Is Surging: Here’s What It Means for the AI Boom
articles.description: CoreWeave's 168% revenue jump sent its shares soaring and lifted Nvidia and other AI stocks. Strong demand is reassuring investors, but the cost of building it remains enormous.

articles.title: Canada’s ambassador warns Trump tariffs are driving up costs, threatening U.S. investment
articles.description: U.S.-Canada trade tensions persist as Trump's tariffs drive up costs, threaten investment and complicate negotiations between the two countries.
